CU31PayPart.dc.html.note: Pixel parity passes and the flow is right (Other 350,000 by Bank with no ref records; ref optional; Paid shows #0531 300,000 · #0544 50,000 · owes 70,000, matching what demo receive_payment books). Fails the money rule: the '70,000 left' on #0544 and 'Owes 420,000 → 70,000' are computed in Pay.tsx, not by src/core/money.ts. Money rule: the per-bill split under 'What it pays' and the dock's 'Owes … → …' come from Pay.tsx's own loop (let left = Math.min(amount, payable); open.map(...)) and its own Math.min(amount, payable), not from src/core/money.ts. That is a second copy of receive_payment's oldest-first allocation (src/core/demo/writes.ts has a third). Fix: add one function to src/core/money.ts (e.g. splitPayment(bills [{id,left}], amount, picks) -> [{id, applied}], oldest first or in ticked order) and use it in Pay.tsx rows and in demo writes.ts; take 'applied' from payPlan(payable, amount).toDebt. Its own commit, named to the lead (src/core).
